description: Farmland tenders in Poland (przetargi na ziemię): KOWR lease and sale (dzierżawa, sprzedaż) from branch schedules. Each: date, gmina and obręb, plots, area and arable ha, starting rent in dt pszenicy or starting price in PLN, restricted or not, distance from a gmina, schedule link. Branches not yet parsed: oddzialy_tylko_harmonogram (PDF links). Also gmina BIP notices on sale, lease and rent of municipal property: field przetargi_gmin.
